jobs.title: AI-Native Motion Designer / Animator
jobs.description: With more than 8 billion downloads, CrazyLabs is a leading publisher of casual and hybrid-casual games. We have proven that real success comes from staying ahead with the latest technology, having fun with what we do and building excellent teams. That’s where you come in! We're hiring an AI-native Motion Designer / Animator to join our top-tier Marketing Video Team, someone who lives at the frontier of AI video creation and uses it to reinvent how user acquisition content gets made. This is not a traditional motion design role with AI tacked on. AI is the engine; motion design is the craft that shapes it. If you are: An experienced AI - Native Motion Designer / Animator Ready to work on long-lasting casual and hybrid casual titles with millions of daily users and their player own communities A strong believer in team work Are not afraid of innovation and learning new tools on the go Approaching your work with joy and genuine curiosity Then you are on the right track to be a great match with CrazyLabs. As an AI-Native Motion Designer / Animator, you wiil: Conceive, generate, and ship high-performing marketing videos for our games using AI video pipelines as your primary toolkit. Drive end-to-end creative workflows in Runway, Kling, Veo, Seedance, Midjourney video, and whatever tool drops next week prompt engineering, model selection, iteration, and refinement are core to the job. Combine AI-generated footage with motion design polish in After Effects and Premiere to deliver final assets that feel intentional, branded, and on-strategy. Partner with UA managers, game designers, and creative leads to translate concepts into AI-driven video at the pace and volume modern UA demands. Run rapid test-and-learn cycles: generate variants, kill what doesn't work, double down on what does. Stay ahead of the curve by evaluating new AI video models, researching and analyzing competitors, sharing findings with the team, and influencing how CrazyLabs develops advertisements. AI-Native Motion Designer / Animator role requires: Deep, hands-on expertise with AI video tools (Runway, Kling, Veo, Seedance, Midjourney video, or similar) — this is the most important qualification. A portfolio or showreel that proves you can ship polished, on-brand video work using AI pipelines — not just experiments, but real output. Strong prompt craft and an instinct for steering generative models toward a specific creative vision. 3+ years in motion design/animation within the mobile gaming industry Good working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (After Effects, Premiere, Animate, Photoshop) — used to finish and elevate AI-generated content into polished, on-brand deliverables. Fluency in editing, compositing, and integrating AI footage with 2D/3D assets and original motion design. A fast, iterative mindset, you'd rather ship five tests than perfect one. Team-oriented and calm under deadline pressure. Experience using AI for ideation, storyboarding, and stylised content creation. Experience with the Unity engine is a plus Passion for mobile games and game culture a big plus. Working within the European Time Zone Bonus Points You've built or contributed to AI video workflows that others on a team now use. You experiment with AI audio (ElevenLabs, Suno) or LLM-driven scripting as part of your creative process. You're plugged into UGC, AI content, and digital storytelling trends and bring them into the work. CrazyLabs commitments Employee benefits are part of our love language. Annual team trip, global holidays celebration and presents, birthday and job anniversary presents… And so so much more! Remote but not alone. jobs.title: Live Operations / Hybrid Casual
jobs.description: With more than 8 billion downloads, CrazyLabs is a leading publisher of casual and hybrid-casual games. We have proven that real success comes from staying ahead with the latest technology, having fun with what we do, and building excellent teams. That’s where you come in! We’re looking for an experienced Game Level Designer to join our Live Operations team and help evolve, expand, and optimize successful puzzle games played by established player communities. This is a hands-on level design role focused on creating high-quality puzzle content at scale and continuously improving the player journey. You’ll combine strong puzzle design intuition with player data, playtests, and experimentation to optimize difficulty, pacing, progression, and long-term engagement across live games. If you are: An experienced Level Designer with a strong background in mobile puzzle games Passionate about designing, playing, and deconstructing puzzle levels Highly skilled in hands-on level creation, balancing, pacing, and difficulty tuning Experienced in working with established games and large volumes of existing levels Able to understand why a puzzle level is satisfying, frustrating, too easy, too difficult, or simply not fun Excited by the combination of creativity, player psychology, and data Comfortable analyzing where players fail, retry, use boosters, progress, or churn Able to create fresh puzzle content for long-term players while maintaining consistency and quality at scale Excited about using AI and new tools to accelerate level creation, balancing, and analysis Then you might be a great match for CrazyLabs. As a Game Level Designer – Live Operations, you will: Design, build, and continuously optimize engaging puzzle levels, missions, challenges, and gameplay content for established mobile games. Create new puzzle levels at scale while maintaining quality, variety, consistency, and alignment with the game’s core mechanics and design principles. Own and continuously improve level progression, sequencing, pacing, and difficulty curves across different stages of the player journey. Analyze level performance through KPIs such as completion rates, fail rates, retries, attempts, churn points, booster usage, and progression behavior, and translate insights into concrete level improvements. Identify difficulty spikes, progression blockers, underperforming levels, and other friction points, and continuously rebalance existing content based on player data and playtests. Design levels that create interesting interactions between mechanics, obstacles, goals, boosters, and board configurations while maintaining clarity and fairness for the player. Define how new mechanics, obstacles, goals, and gameplay elements are introduced, taught, combined, and evolved throughout the level journey. Experiment with new combinations of existing mechanics to create fresh puzzle experiences without unnecessary complexity. Design puzzle levels, missions, and challenges for LiveOps events, limited-time content, and other engagement-driven experiences. Balance challenge and accessibility across different player segments while maintaining a satisfying sense of mastery and progression. Support A/B tests related to level difficulty, sequencing, progression, balancing, and puzzle content, and iterate based on their results. Work closely with Product Owners and Data Analysts to identify friction points within the level funnel, define hypotheses, evaluate results, and improve progression and engagement KPIs. Collaborate with Game Designers, developers, artists, and other disciplines to integrate new mechanics, boosters, obstacles, and features into the level experience. Contribute ideas for new puzzle mechanics, obstacles, goals, boosters, and level-design opportunities based on player behavior and the needs of the existing game. Create and maintain clear level-design documentation, including progression plans, difficulty frameworks, balancing sheets, level layouts, mechanic-introduction plans, and design guidelines. Continuously play and analyze successful mobile puzzle games to identify level-design patterns, difficulty strategies, mechanics, progression structures, and emerging market trends. Use AI tools to accelerate level ideation, content variation, balancing, testing, research, and performance analysis. The Game Level Designer – Live Operations role requires: Proven level-design experience in mobile F2P games, with strong hands-on experience in puzzle games. Strong hands-on puzzle level-design experience, including level creation, implementation, balancing, pacing, difficulty tuning, and progression. Experience designing and maintaining levels for a live mobile game with an established player base. Strong understanding of puzzle level-design principles, including board design, goals, constraints, mechanic combinations, difficulty curves, pacing, player learning, and progression. Proven ability to create high-quality puzzle levels at scale while maintaining variety, consistency, and an appropriate difficulty curve. Strong understanding of how mechanics, obstacles, boosters, goals, and board configurations interact to influence level difficulty and player behavior. Experience using level KPIs, analytics, spreadsheets, playtests, and player data to make data-driven level-design and balancing decisions. Ability to identify difficulty spikes, progression blockers, and problematic levels and translate performance data into concrete design changes. Experience continuously rebalancing existing content based on completion rates, fail rates, attempts, retries, churn, booster usage, and other relevant player behaviors. Experience working with level editors, game engines, spreadsheets, or other content-creation and balancing tools. Strong understanding of the F2P puzzle player journey and how level difficulty, progression, and content variety influence engagement and retention. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills combined with creativity, attention to detail, and player empathy. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Strong knowledge of the mobile puzzle market and current level-design trends. Curiosity and willingness to experiment with AI tools and emerging technologies as part of the level-design workflow. Advantage 3+ years of experience specifically designing levels for successful mobile puzzle games. Experience working on a large-scale puzzle title with an established player base and a mature level funnel. Experience designing and maintaining hundreds or thousands of puzzle levels. Experience owning or significantly contributing to difficulty curves and progression for a live puzzle game. Experience optimizing puzzle levels using completion, failure, retry, churn, booster usage, and progression data. Experience creating puzzle content for LiveOps events, limited-time challenges, or recurring events. Experience introducing and balancing new mechanics, blockers, obstacles, goals, or boosters within an existing puzzle game. Experience working with large-scale or automated level-production pipelines. Proficiency in Unity 3D or custom level editors. Create and prototype AI-generated video concepts for mobile game ads, from initial idea through production-ready creative. Work closely with marketers, artists, video creators, and AI specialists to turn creative and production needs into scalable AI solutions. ﻿Must-Haves A portfolio or showreel demonstrating relevant creative work, experiments, AI projects, video work, or personal projects. Strong creative and visual sense, with a good understanding of video, composition, movement, storytelling, and pacing. Hands-on experience with generative AI tools, especially AI image and video generation platforms. A strong hands-on experimentation mindset: you actively follow new developments in AI video, creative AI, and related technologies, and constantly try new models, platforms, workflows, free tiers, trials, coupons, betas, and anything else that lets you explore what is possible. Ability to take a creative problem, test different approaches, and turn successful experiments into a repeatable workflow. Strong attention to detail and a desire to produce polished creative results. Big Advantages Experience with tools or platforms such as Kling, Seedance, Veo, Runway, ComfyUI, Weavy, Adobe, or similar AI creative tools. Experience creating or editing video content for mobile games, advertising, social media, or performance marketing. Understanding of User Acquisition creative, mobile game ads, hooks, CPI testing, or creative iteration. Experience building automations for video creation, creative production, or ad testing. Hands-on experience with Claude Code, Codex, or similar AI coding tools — personal and home projects are absolutely welcome. Experience with cloud environments, Linux, Kubernetes, or similar infrastructure technologies. Experience with video editing, motion graphics, animation, VFX, or game art. Why Join Us? Join CrazyLabs’ AI team and work hands-on with some of the fastest-moving technologies in generative video. You’ll have the opportunity to experiment with new AI models as they emerge, turn experiments into real production workflows, and directly influence how AI is used to create and scale video advertising for mobile games. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career who combines creative instincts, a builder mindset, and a passion for AI, and wants to grow alongside a rapidly evolving field.
